name: archaeoforge
description: Evidence-controlled historical-site reconstruction and lifelike visualization workflows for ArchaeoForge.

interface.longDescription: Drive an installed ArchaeoForge pipeline from Codex: create site projects, review evidence, validate and render dated geometry, turn model renders into lifelike historical scenes, and register derived images with hash-bound provenance.
defaultPrompt: Build an evidence-controlled reconstruction of a historical site at a specified date.
Turn my ArchaeoForge model render into a lifelike historical scene with provenance.
Inspect my ArchaeoForge project and continue safely from its first incomplete stage.
